SELECT su.*, sjt.name AS job_type_name, st.name AS team_name, sps.name AS person_status_name, sa.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS create_name, u2.user_name AS update_name, sd.name AS dept_name, sr.role_name AS role_name FROM sys_user su -- 关联岗位类型表 LEFT JOIN sys_job_type sjt ON su.job_type_id = sjt.sys_job_type_id AND sjt.deleted = 0 -- 关联班组表 LEFT JOIN sys_team st ON su.team_id = st.sys_team_id AND st.deleted = 0 -- 关联人员状态表 LEFT JOIN sys_person_status sps ON su.person_status_id = sps.sys_person_status_id AND sps.deleted = 0 -- 关联区域表 LEFT JOIN sys_area sa ON su.area_code = sa.area_code AND sa.deleted = 0 -- 关联创建人 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON su.create_by = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 -- 关联更新人 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON su.update_by = u2.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 -- 关联部门表 LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON su.dept_id = sd.sys_dept_id AND sd.deleted = 0 -- 关联角色表 LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON su.role_id = sr.role_id AND sr.deleted = 0
ORDER BY su.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) FROM sys_user su -- 关联关联表 LEFT JOIN sys_job_type sjt ON su.job_type_id = sjt.sys_job_type_id AND sjt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_team st ON su.team_id = st.sys_team_id AND st.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_person_status sps ON su.person_status_id = sps.sys_person_status_id AND sps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area sa ON su.area_code = sa.area_code AND sa.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON su.create_by = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON su.update_by = u2.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON su.dept_id = sd.sys_dept_id AND sd.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON su.role_id = sr.role_id AND sr.deleted = 0
